title: Grateful Dead Live at Field House - University of Cincinnati on 1970-04-03

ai_review.summary: Good soundboard capture of a solid 1970 set featuring an acoustic opening, standout Black Peter and The Other One, with minor pitch and pop issues but clean track flow.
ai_review.review: The recording is a sound‑board source that generally sounds clear, though a few listeners note it runs slightly low in pitch and contains occasional pops and static. Musically the show shines – an acoustic set opens the night, Black Peter, The Other One and Lovelight are highlighted as intense moments, and Pigpen’s late‑show scream adds extra excitement.

ai_rating.rationale: Five detailed reviews give an average of 4.4 stars; the show is praised for its acoustic set and strong late‑set songs while recording issues are minor, yielding a high overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Slight half‑step low pitch/slow tempo noted by one reviewer; occasional pops, crackles and stray static mentioned; track splits for China Cat/Sunflower, Rider and Good Lovin' are handled cleanly, and The Other One is presented as a single continuous track.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Fans appreciate the acoustic set opening, smooth transitions (no unwanted track changes) and a strong closing stretch featuring The Other One through Lovelight.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia adds lyric improvisations on the acoustic Friend of the Devil and shines in the intimate setting.
band_member_comments.Drums: Drums stay intact in Good Lovin' with no interruptions.
